claim_being_audited: That the model can be certified for launch on the current record because aggregate readiness passed and no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, provided the unresolved cybersecurity alert-triage limitation is disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
decision_criteria: Policy requires disclosure of material limitations for named launch use cases unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Certification without material caveats requires current evidence of no remaining material weakness or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one incidents are supportive but do not by themselves negate a current named-use-case weakness.
Draft monitoring or rollback proposals support risk management but do not remove the disclosure requirement unless approved.
evidence_requests: Approved risk acceptance, if one exists, covering the cybersecurity alert-triage limitation before launch.
An approved mitigation record with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Final model-card text showing the limitation is disclosed for the named launch use case, or evidence that the issue was resolved before launch.
A materiality determination explaining why this below-target slice would not count as a material limitation, if that is the position.
specific_concerns: The record shows a current below-target weakness in a named launch use case: cybersecurity alert triage for lateral-movement alert summarization.
The proposed mitigation is still draft and lacks required approval details: accountable owner and alert threshold are TBD.
The model-card draft currently states there are no known material limitations, which conflicts with the unresolved slice issue and reviewer concern.
The actor's recommended action is 'certify_model', but the admissible support is only for certification if the limitation is explicitly disclosed or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.

Public guidance about documenting limitations and monitoring risk supports governance practice, but it does not itself satisfy the policy predicate for removing or ignoring the disclosure requirement.
unsupported_claims: Any unqualified implication that the current record supports certification without material caveats.
Any implication that the draft runbook materially closes the gap for policy purposes before approval details are complete.
Any implication that there are no known material limitations in the current model card draft.
